name: API Connection
description: Helper module that provides generic API connection functionality.
project_description: API Connection is a developer helper module that lets a Drupal site connect to external REST APIs / web services through a plugin architecture. Each API integration is declared as a RestApiConnection plugin (annotation or PHP attribute) in a custom module, with per-environment base URLs (dev / test / live) and an activated flag. The RestApiConnectionBase base class wraps Drupal's Guzzle http_client_factory and exposes a single sendRequest() method that resolves the base URL for the current environment, JSON-encodes the body, sets default headers, sends the request, and decodes the response. A site-wide settings form selects the active environment and toggles request/response logging to the Drupal logger. It provides no end-user feature on its own; it is infrastructure consumed by other modules, and ships an api_connection_example submodule demonstrating a ReqRes.in integration.
